newsitem.title: USA: Kansas community to debate $78 mln bond issuance.
newsitem.headline: Kansas community to debate $78 mln bond issuance.

text.p: City officials of a Kansas City, Kan., suburb have scheduled a public hearing Tuesday night on a plan to issue $78 million of industrial revenue bonds for a new Allied Signal Commercial Avionics Systems headquarters, the city manager said.

Allied Signal, which manufactures aircraft safety equipment, would also receive $19 million of property tax breaks for its proposed 520,000 square foot manufacturing and headquarters facility in southwest suburban Olathe, city manager Michael McCurdy said.
The plan calls for a 100 percent property tax abatement for the first five years at the site and a 50 percent abatement for the following five years, McCurdy said.
The City Council is expected to vote on the plan June 17, McCurdy said. The bonds are to be sold in two series, he added.
